Send events from your app

Use a script tag, an SDK, or the HTTP API. The browser and Node.js SDK can check event names and properties in TypeScript and retry delivery with the same event ID.

Browser and Node.js SDKMobile & Exact SDKs
import { createBrowserClient } from "@birdwatch/sdk";

Run Birdwatch locally

Unzip Birdwatch and run the command from its folder. Open http://127.0.0.1:8123 to explore the demo or create a project.

Read the setup guide
Terminal
$ python3 server.py
